scope: All regular FB7.3/FB7.4 evaluation, audit, cost and failed-attempt files through accepted costs1. Raw partition symlinks are excluded; their exact targets are included once under attempt2. Later delivery receipts are committed in Git.
extraction: Materialize the exact Library/file identity; verify archive bytes and SHA-256 before extracting at the repository root. Verify every member against the included Raw_SHA256.json. Original historical inputs remain in their existing pinned archives. For partition replay, recreate each file symlink from its summary to ../attempt2/<file>; alternatively run the unchanged serial verifier on attempt2.
